description: This file contains code for registering, validating, and unregistering a service worker in a web application, including environment checks and update handling.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Main function to register the service worker if conditions are met, including environment and hostname checks.

methods.name: registerValidSW
methods.description: Registers the service worker and sets up update and state change handlers.

methods.name: checkValidServiceWorker
methods.description: Checks if the service worker script exists and is valid, reloads page if not.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the service worker if supported.
